ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for manual review of a suspected SAFE-1 code-of-conduct breach: read the rider's complaint and the driver's chat message in context, obtain both parties' accounts, and decide whether account action is warranted; advise the rider of the RydeHELP report path and of 995 / driver commercial insurance if she requires assistance. No automated refund is executed while the safety screen stands.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen (primary, mandatory in every case): the dispute type is "safety" and the rider's complaint states "The driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out." The in-app chat is only two messages and corroborates: 17:09:35 rider "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." → 17:10:30 driver "Sit down or I lock the doors." Read in context, this is not a pickup arrangement or a benign instruction: it is a verbal threat of confinement ("or I lock the doors") issued directly in response to a request to stop and exit, i.e. intimidation aimed at the other party, and the rider reports feeling unsafe for the whole ride. The driver's own account ("I told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on") does not deny the words. Under SAFE-1 (Ryde code of conduct bars threats, intimidation and abuse of any kind, "will not be tolerated"), and because the dispute type is safety, I do not rule on the merits: ruling = escalate, escalate = true, safety_concern = confirmed. Safety basis: (1) rider complaint of a threat to lock her in; (2) driver chat message 17:10:30 "Sit down or I lock the doors"; (3) rider's stated sustained feeling of unsafety during the ride. RydeHELP / 995 / driver commercial insurance paths noted for the human reviewer. Secondary observations (for the reviewer, not decided here): this was a RydeX fixed-price trip, total S$32.86 = base 3.90 + distance 21.82 + time 5.67 + platform 1.47, no tolls, no cancellation fee, waiting fee 0; no off-route segment is established in the record (the GPS trace from 17:08:20 onward tracks the quoted corridor to Bedok Mall, arriving 17:31:40), and the driver did not stop at the point requested (the rider's 17:09:35 request was never accepted). Evidence status: sufficient to trigger the safety screen (chat, complaint, statement, GPS and timeline all present); the merits are not adjudicated by design.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1: rider complaint plus driver chat message constitute a suspected/confirmed threat and intimidation (threat to lock the rider in when she asked to exit); dispute type is safety, so no automated ruling is issued and the case is referred to a human reviewer.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he told the rider to sit down 'for her own safety'; the chat text ('Sit down or I lock the doors') is an explicit threat of confinement, and a safety rationale does not license intimidation. Not accepted as a defence; the safety screen stands and the merits go to a human.
